prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: If I had studied harder, I _____ in a better school now.
options: would be
would have been
will be

wrong.would have been: now 指現在，結果是現在的狀態，要用 would be，不是 would have been。
wrong.will be: 這是與事實相反的假設，主句要用 would，不是 will。

why: 過去的原因（沒用功）造成現在的結果，是混合假設：had p.p.，would + 原形。
tip: 過去原因加現在結果：had p.p. 搭 would be。
say: If I had studied harder, I would be in a better school now.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: _____ I known the truth, I would have told you.
options: Had
If
Were

wrong.If: If I known 缺少 had，若保留 if，要寫成 If I had known。
wrong.Were: were 用於 Were I 的現在假設，不能接過去分詞 known。

why: 省略 if 的過去假設，把 had 移到句首：Had I known。
tip: 省略 if，had 移到句首。
say: Had I known the truth, I would have told you.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: Should you need help, please call me.
Should you will need help, please call me.
Should you needed help, please call me.
answer: Should you need help, please call me.

wrong.Should you will need help, please call m: should 後面已經是假設語氣，不能再加 will。
should 之後動詞用原形，不能用過去式。

why: Should + 主詞 + 原形，是省略 if 的倒裝，意思是「萬一…」。
tip: Should 倒裝句後面動詞用原形。
say: Should you need help, please call me.

prompt: 今天下過雨，你們現在沒有在海邊。你想說「要不是下雨，我們現在就在海邊了」。哪一句最適合？
options: If it hadn't rained, we would be at the beach now.
If it didn't rain, we would have been at the beach now.
If it hadn't rained, we would have been at the beach now.
answer: If it hadn't rained, we would be at the beach now.

wrong.If it didn't rain, we would have been at: 過去的原因要用 hadn't rained，現在的結果要用 would be，兩邊時態都放錯了。
wrong.If it hadn't rained, we would have been: if 子句正確，但 now 表示現在，主句應該用 would be，不是 would have been。

why: 過去下雨（原因）造成現在不在海邊（結果），用混合假設。
tip: 原因在過去、結果在現在，就是混合假設。
say: If it hadn't rained, we would be at the beach now.

prompt: 這個句子的意思是什麼？
text: Were I in your position, I would accept the offer.
options: 如果我是你，我會接受這份邀約
我在你的位置上，接受了邀約
我不確定要不要接受邀約
answer: 如果我是你，我會接受這份邀約

wrong.我在你的位置上，接受了邀約: Were I ... would 是假設語氣，說的是不存在的情況，沒有接受。
wrong.我不確定要不要接受邀約: 句子的語氣很肯定，表示「我會接受」，不是不確定。

why: Were I = If I were，是假設語氣的倒裝。
tip: Were I 等於 If I were。
say: Were I in your position, I would accept the offer.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: _____ it not been for the rain, the game would have gone on.
options: Had
Were
Should

wrong.Were: were 用於現在的假設，這裡後面是 been（過去分詞），要用 Had。
wrong.Should: should 表示萬一，不能和 not been 組成與過去事實相反的假設。

why: Had it not been for 表示「要不是…」，用於過去的假設。
tip: 要不是：Had it not been for。
say: Had it not been for the rain, the game would have gone on.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: Were he taller, he would join the basketball team.
Was he taller, he would join the basketball team.
Were he is taller, he would join the basketball team.
answer: Were he taller, he would join the basketball team.

wrong.Was he taller, he would join the basketb: 倒裝的假設句固定用 Were，不能用 Was。
wrong.Were he is taller, he would join the bas: were 已經是動詞，後面不能再加 is，會變成兩個動詞。

why: Were he taller 是 If he were taller 的倒裝。
tip: 省略 if 的假設，be 動詞固定用 Were。
say: Were he taller, he would join the basketball team.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: If he _____ so careless yesterday, he wouldn't be in trouble today.
options: hadn't been
weren't
isn't

wrong.weren't: yesterday 是過去，要用 hadn't been，不是現在假設的 weren't。
wrong.isn't: if 子句要用假設語氣，isn't 是現在式，不符合。

why: 昨天的行為（過去）造成今天的麻煩（現在），if 子句用 hadn't been。
tip: 過去的原因：if 加 hadn't p.p.。
say: If he hadn't been so careless yesterday, he wouldn't be in trouble today.

prompt: 你在公告上想說「如果有任何問題，請聯絡我」，語氣正式。哪一句最適合？
options: Should you have any questions, please contact me.
Should you will have any questions, please contact me.
Do you have any question, please contact me.
answer: Should you have any questions, please contact me.

wrong.Should you will have any questions, plea: should 後面直接接原形動詞，不能再加 will。
wrong.Do you have any question, please contact: 疑問句形式不能代替 if 子句，兩個句子只用逗號連接也是錯的。

why: Should you have ... 是 If you should have ... 的正式倒裝。
tip: 正式場合常用 Should you 加原形。
say: Should you have any questions, please contact me.

prompt: 這個句子的意思是什麼？
text: Had she left earlier, she would have avoided the storm.
options: 她當時沒有早點出門，所以遇上了暴風雨
她早點出門，所以避開了暴風雨
她早點出門，卻還是遇上暴風雨
answer: 她當時沒有早點出門，所以遇上了暴風雨

wrong.她早點出門，所以避開了暴風雨: 假設語氣表示與事實相反，事實是她沒有早點出門。
wrong.她早點出門，卻還是遇上暴風雨: would have avoided 表示如果早走就能避開，不是仍然遇上。

why: Had she left 是與過去事實相反的假設，實際上她沒有早走。
tip: 假設語氣的意思要反過來讀。
say: Had she left earlier, she would have avoided the storm.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: If I _____ born ten years earlier, I would be a retired athlete now.
options: had been
would have been
have been

wrong.would have been: would have been 是主句用法，if 子句裡不能用 would。
wrong.have been: have been 是現在完成式，不能用於與過去事實相反的假設。

why: 與過去事實相反，if 子句用 had been。
tip: if 子句的過去假設用 had p.p.。
say: If I had been born ten years earlier, I would be a retired athlete now.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: Had I not missed the bus, I would have arrived on time.
Had not I missed the bus, I would have arrived on time.
Did I not miss the bus, I would have arrived on time.
answer: Had I not missed the bus, I would have arrived on time.

wrong.Had not I missed the bus, I would have a: 倒裝句中 not 要放在主詞之後，不能放在主詞前面。
wrong.Did I not miss the bus, I would have arr: 過去假設要用 Had，Did 不能代替 if 引導與過去事實相反的假設。

why: Had I not missed 是 If I had not missed 的倒裝，not 放在主詞後。
tip: 倒裝假設的否定：Had + 主詞 + not。
say: Had I not missed the bus, I would have arrived on time.
